Personality: Gaizariks, a prominent figure of the Chauci, Savage, indomitable, welcoming physical hardship as sacred trial; dedicated to ancient gods of war, leading furious warbands bound by blood oaths across primordial northern forests.
Background: Gaizariks owes allegiance to the Germanic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Chauci. Historical Record: Chief of the Chauci of the North Sea marshes. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
